{"path": "model.py", "content": "from __future__ import annotations

import math

import cadquery as cq
from sdk import (
    ArticulatedObject,
    ArticulationType,
    Box,
    Cylinder,
    MotionLimits,
    Origin,
    TestContext,
    TestReport,
    mesh_from_cadquery,
)


CLEARANCE = 0.00035
LEG_LENGTH = 0.150
PHONE_MIN = 0.065
PHONE_MAX = 0.085


def leg_shape() -> cq.Workplane:
    body = (
        cq.Workplane("XZ")
        .moveTo(0.0, -0.010)
        .lineTo(0.110, -0.0075)
        .lineTo(LEG_LENGTH - 0.012, -0.009)
        .threePointArc((LEG_LENGTH - 0.004, 0.0), (LEG_LENGTH - 0.012, 0.009))
        .lineTo(0.110, 0.0075)
        .lineTo(0.0, 0.010)
        .close()
        .extrude(0.011, both=True)
    )
    foot = (
        cq.Workplane("YZ")
        .ellipse(0.010, 0.007)
        .extrude(0.016)
        .translate((LEG_LENGTH - 0.016, 0.0, 0.0))
    )
    return body.union(foot)


def ring_shape() -> cq.Workplane:
    ring = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.023).circle(0.0166 + CLEARANCE).extrude(0.014)
    lug = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.016, 0.014, 0.014).translate((0.023, 0.0, 0.0))
    return ring.union(lug)


def jaw_shape() -> cq.Workplane:
    body = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.018, 0.018, 0.092)
    cavity = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.012, 0.012, 0.078).translate((0.002, 0.0, 0.0))
    lip = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.006, 0.018, 0.014).translate((-0.006, 0.0, -0.039))
    bolt_hole = cq.Workplane("YZ").circle(0.0032).extrude(0.024)
    return body.cut(cavity).union(lip).cut(bolt_hole)


def build_object_model() -> ArticulatedObject:
    model = ArticulatedObject(name="desktop_folding_tripod_phone_stand")

    black = model.material("black", rgba=(0.10, 0.10, 0.11, 1.0))
    dark_gray = model.material("dark_gray", rgba=(0.20, 0.21, 0.22, 1.0))
    rubber = model.material("rubber", rgba=(0.07, 0.07, 0.07, 1.0))
    steel = model.material("steel", rgba=(0.45, 0.47, 0.50, 1.0))

    base = model.part("base")
    base.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.016, length=0.160), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.080)), material=black, name="center_post")
    base.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.022, length=0.022), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.127)), material=dark_gray, name="leg_hub")
    base.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.018, length=0.012), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.006)), material=rubber, name="bottom_cap")
    base.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.011, length=0.080), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.174)), material=black, name="head_stem")

    slide_ring = model.part("slide_ring")
    slide_ring.visual(mesh_from_cadquery(ring_shape(), "slide_ring"), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.007)), material=dark_gray, name="ring_body")
    model.articulation(
        "base_to_slide_ring",
        ArticulationType.PRISMATIC,
        parent=base,
        child=slide_ring,
        origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.070)),
        axis=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
        motion_limits=MotionLimits(effort=18.0, velocity=0.08, lower=0.0, upper=0.058),
    )

    for index, angle in enumerate((0.0, 2.0 * math.pi / 3.0, 4.0 * math.pi / 3.0)):
        leg = model.part(f"leg_{index}")
        leg.visual(mesh_from_cadquery(leg_shape(), f"leg_{index}_shape"), origin=Origin(xyz=(LEG_LENGTH / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0)), material=black, name="leg_body")
        leg.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.009, length=0.018), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), rpy=(math.pi / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0)), material=dark_gray, name="hinge_barrel")
        leg.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.0085, length=0.015), origin=Origin(xyz=(LEG_LENGTH - 0.008, 0.0, -0.001), rpy=(math.pi / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0)), material=rubber, name="foot")
        model.articulation(
            f"base_to_leg_{index}",
            ArticulationType.REVOLUTE,
            parent=base,
            child=leg,
            origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.127), rpy=(0.0, 0.0, angle)),
            axis=(0.0, -1.0, 0.0),
            motion_limits=MotionLimits(effort=8.0, velocity=2.0, lower=0.0, upper=1.05),
        )

    head = model.part("head")
    head.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.014, length=0.020), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.010)), material=dark_gray, name="yaw_base")
    head.visual(mesh_from_cadquery(cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.024, 0.030, 0.020), "tilt_block"), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.030)), material=black, name="tilt_block")
    head.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.008, length=0.034), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.030), rpy=(0.0, math.pi / 2.0, 0.0)), material=dark_gray, name="tilt_axle")
    model.articulation("base_to_head", ArticulationType.FIXED, parent=base, child=head, origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.200)))

    cradle = model.part("cradle")
    cradle.visual(mesh_from_cadquery(cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.022, 0.040, 0.065), "back_plate"), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0325)), material=black, name="back_plate")
    cradle.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.013, length=0.010), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.010)), material=dark_gray, name="tilt_hub")
    cradle.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.003, length=0.022), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.006, 0.0, 0.032), rpy=(0.0, math.pi / 2.0, 0.0)), material=steel, name="mount_bolt")
    model.articulation(
        "head_to_cradle",
        ArticulationType.REVOLUTE,
        parent=head,
        child=cradle,
        origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.030)),
        axis=(0.0, -1.0, 0.0),

import math

from sdk import (
    ArticulatedObject,

PHONE_MIN = 0.065
PHONE_MAX = 0.085
CLAMP_TRAVEL = PHONE_MAX - PHONE_MIN


def build_object_model() -> ArticulatedObject:
    model = ArticulatedObject(name="desktop_folding_tripod_phone_stand")

    black = model.material("black", rgba=(0.10, 0.10, 0.11, 1.0))
    dark_gray = model.material("dark_gray", rgba=(0.20, 0.21, 0.22, 1.0))
    rubber = model.material("rubber", rgba=(0.07, 0.07, 0.07, 1.0))
    steel = model.material("steel", rgba=(0.45, 0.47, 0.50, 1.0))

    base = model.part("base")
    base.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.016, length=0.160), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.080)), material=black, name="center_post")
    base.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.026, length=0.026), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.125)), material=dark_gray, name="leg_hub")
    base.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.018, length=0.012), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.006)), material=rubber, name="bottom_cap")
    base.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.010, length=0.060), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.183)), material=black, name="head_stem")

    slide_ring = model.part("slide_ring")
    slide_ring.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.024, length=0.012), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.006)), material=dark_gray, name="ring_shell")
    slide_ring.visual(Box((0.014, 0.012, 0.012)), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.025, 0.0, 0.006)), material=dark_gray, name="ring_lug")
    model.articulation(
        "base_to_slide_ring",
        ArticulationType.PRISMATIC,
        parent=base,
        child=slide_ring,
        origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.072)),
        axis=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
        motion_limits=MotionLimits(effort=18.0, velocity=0.08, lower=0.0, upper=0.055),
    )

    leg_angles = (0.0, 2.0 * math.pi / 3.0, 4.0 * math.pi / 3.0)
    for index, angle in enumerate(leg_angles):
        leg = model.part(f"leg_{index}")
        leg.visual(Box((LEG_LENGTH, 0.020, 0.014)), origin=Origin(xyz=(LEG_LENGTH / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0)), material=black, name="leg_body")
        leg.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.008, length=0.024), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), rpy=(math.pi / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0)), material=dark_gray, name="hinge_barrel")

            ArticulationType.REVOLUTE,
            parent=base,

    head.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.006, length=0.040), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.014), rpy=(0.0, math.pi / 2.0, 0.0)), material=steel, name="tilt_axle")

    cradle = model.part("cradle")

    cradle.visual(Box((0.018, 0.020, 0.024)), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.012)), material=dark_gray, name="tilt_hub")
    cradle.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.003, length=0.022), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.006, 0.0, 0.060), rpy=(0.0, math.pi / 2.0, 0.0)), material=steel, name="mount_bolt")
    cradle.visual(Box((0.034, 0.010, 0.010)), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.018, 0.0, 0.060)), material=dark_gray, name="slider_rail")
    model.articulation(
        "head_to_cradle",
        ArticulationType.REVOLUTE,
        parent=head,
        child=cradle,
        origin=Origin(xyz=(0.0, 0.0, 0.014)),
        axis=(0.0, -1.0, 0.0),
        motion_limits=MotionLimits(effort=4.0, velocity=1.5, lower=math.radians(-20.0), upper=math.radians(75.0)),
    )

    jaw_fixed = model.part("jaw_fixed")
    jaw_fixed.visual(Box((0.018, 0.018, 0.092)), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.009, 0.0, 0.046)), material=black, name="jaw_body")
    jaw_fixed.visual(Box((0.006, 0.018, 0.014)), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.003, 0.0, 0.007)), material=black, name="lip")
    jaw_fixed.visual(Box((0.014, 0.020, 0.050)), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.017, 0.0, 0.046)), material=dark_gray, name="mount_block")
    jaw_fixed.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.0032, length=0.022), origin=Origin(xyz=(0.009, 0.0, 0.046), rpy=(0.0, math.pi / 2.0, 0.0)), material=steel, name="bolt_hole")
    model.articulation("cradle_to_jaw_fixed", ArticulationType.FIXED, parent=cradle, child=jaw_fixed, origin=Origin(xyz=(0.018, -0.041, 0.014)))

    jaw_moving = model.part("jaw_moving")
    jaw_moving.visual(Box((0.018, 0.018, 0.092)), origin=Origin(xyz=(-0.009, 0.0, 0.046)), material=black, name="jaw_body")
    jaw_moving.visual(Box((0.006, 0.018, 0.014)), origin=Origin(xyz=(-0.003, 0.0, 0.007)), material=black, name="lip")
    jaw_moving.visual(Box((0.034, 0.010, 0.010)), origin=Origin(xyz=(-0.017, 0.0, 0.046)), material=dark_gray, name="slider_block")
    jaw_moving.visual(Cylinder(radius=0.004, length=0.020), origin=Origin(xyz=(-0.028, 0.0, 0.046), rpy=(0.0, math.pi / 2.0, 0.0)), material=steel, name="clamp_bolt")
    model.articulation(

        parent=cradle,
        child=jaw_moving,
        origin=Origin(xyz=(0.018, 0.02435, 0.014)),
        axis=(0.0, 1.0, 0.0),
        motion_limits=MotionLimits(effort=10.0, velocity=0.03, lower=0.0, upper=CLAMP_TRAVEL),
    )

    return model


def run_tests() -> TestReport:
    ctx = TestContext(object_model)
    base = object_model.get_part("base")
    slide_ring = object_model.get_part("slide_ring")
    cradle = object_model.get_part("cradle")
    jaw_fixed = object_model.get_part("jaw_fixed")
    jaw_moving = object_model.get_part("jaw_moving")
    pitch = object_model.get_articulation("head_to_cradle")
    slider = object_model.get_articulation("cradle_to_jaw_moving")
    ring_joint = object_model.get_articulation("base_to_slide_ring")

    ctx.allow_overlap(slide_ring, base, elem_a="ring_shell", elem_b="center_post", reason="The sliding ring is intentionally represented as a sleeve around the center post.")
    ctx.expect_overlap(slide_ring, base, axes="z", elem_a="ring_shell", elem_b="center_post", min_overlap=0.010, name="slide ring remains captured on post")
    ctx.expect_gap(jaw_moving, jaw_fixed, axis="y", positive_elem="jaw_body", negative_elem="jaw_body", min_gap=PHONE_MIN - 0.0005, max_gap=PHONE_MIN + 0.0005, name="default clamp width matches minimum phone width")
    with ctx.pose({slider: CLAMP_TRAVEL}):
        ctx.expect_gap(jaw_moving, jaw_fixed, axis="y", positive_elem="jaw_body", negative_elem="jaw_body", min_gap=PHONE_MAX - 0.0005, max_gap=PHONE_MAX + 0.0005, name="extended clamp width matches maximum phone width")
    with ctx.pose({pitch: math.radians(75.0)}):
        ctx.expect_origin_gap(cradle, base, axis="z", min_gap=0.05, name="pitched head lifts cradle above base")
    with ctx.pose({ring_joint: 0.055}):
        ctx.expect_origin_gap(slide_ring, base, axis="z", min_gap=0.11, name="ring moves upward in folded state")

    return ctx.report()

    jaw_moving = object_model.get_part("jaw_moving")

    ctx.expect_gap(jaw_moving, jaw_fixed, axis="y", positive_elem="jaw_body", negative_elem="jaw_body", min_gap=PHONE_MIN - 0.0005, max_gap=PHONE_MIN + 0.0005, name="default clamp width matches minimum phone width")

    with ctx.pose({ring_joint: 0.055}):
        ctx.expect_origin_gap(slide_ring, base, axis="z", min_gap=0.11, name="ring moves upward in folded state")

    return ctx.report()
